title: Case 042: Payment batch validation report
initial_request: I uploaded a supplier payment batch for Fenwick Workshop, but it did not pass validation. Please make the row-level error report available to me so I can review what needs correcting.
overview: Nadia Fenwick, an authorised file uploader with permission to view validation reports, escalated a failed payment-batch validation through secure chat. The bank’s import service provided a report identifying a missing payee label on row 2. No corrected batch was submitted and no payment execution was confirmed.

next_action.summary: Request the validation report from the import service for Nadia as an authorised report viewer.

outcome: The validation report for batch HV-042 is available in the secure portal and identifies a missing required payee label on row 2. No corrected batch has been received, and no payment execution is confirmed.

events.body: Validation status: FAILED. The payment batch did not pass validation.
I uploaded batch HV-042 for Fenwick Workshop, but I can’t see which rows need attention. I’m authorised to view the report; please help me access it.
I’ve checked Nadia Fenwick’s permission to view validation reports. Please retrieve the validation report for batch HV-042 for her secure-portal access.

Your validation report, validation-042.txt, is available in the secure portal. Batch HV-042 | 16 July 2025; Validation status: FAILED; Row 2: missing required payee label. No corrected batch received; no payment execution confirmed.

I can confirm that validation-042.txt is available in your secure portal and reports a missing required payee label on row 2. No corrected batch has been submitted; you can review the report and decide whether to prepare and submit a correction.
